$memorySamples=@()

$gpuSummary=& nvidia-smi --query-gpu=name,uuid,driver_version,memory.total,memory.used,memory.free,utilization.gpu --format=csv,noheader,nounits 2>&1
$gpuExit=$LASTEXITCODE
$gpuProcessQuery=& nvidia-smi --query-compute-apps=pid,process_name,used_memory --format=csv,noheader,nounits 2>&1
